style_en: Japanese TV anime style, clean bold line art, cel shading, calm muted colors, bright even light. Plain pure white background (#FFFFFF), no floor, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no frame. Full body fully inside the image, filling the height, one single character centered.
avoid_en: text, letters, logo, modern clothes, Chinese-style clothing, nudity, blood, multiple characters, background scenery

kushinada.desc_en: Kushinada-hime, a young maiden of ancient Izumo about 16 years old, long straight black hair tied low at the back with a white cord, a few rice-plant ornaments in her hair, a simple white Kofun-period kinu tunic over a long pale green mo skirt, a thin string of small red magatama beads, barefoot, a quiet serious face with large dark eyes

susanoo.desc_en: Susanoo, a wild young male storm god of ancient Japan about 25 years old, untidy long black hair partly tied in rough mizura loops, a short stubble beard, fierce sharp eyes, a dark indigo Kofun-period kinu tunic with a rope belt and grey hakama trousers tied below the knees, a long straight iron sword (totsuka no tsurugi) at the waist, barefoot

ashinazuchi.desc_en: Ashinazuchi, an old earthly god of Izumo about 70 years old, a thin bent old man with white hair tied in small mizura loops and a long white beard, a worn pale brown Kofun-period tunic and trousers, a straw rope belt, barefoot, a tired sorrowful face
